name: Linkwarden
note: Collaborative bookmark manager that archives each page as a screenshot, PDF and single HTML file (Next.js + a Node worker, PostgreSQL). HELD 2026-11-17: every archive format goes through Chromium, and public Wolfi chromium has been frozen at 149.0.7827.53 since June 2026 with over 1,600 fixable findings, the same wall that holds Gotenberg. The recipe builds and is kept ready; re-check when a scannable Chromium source exists.

name: Docmost
note: Collaborative wiki and documentation with real-time editing (Node + PostgreSQL + Redis). Sized 2026-11-16 at v0.97.0: CVE-light (7 fixable lockfile findings in 6 packages, none without a fix), but apps/server/src/ee, apps/client/src/ee and packages/ee are under the Docmost Enterprise License, which allows production use only with a paid subscription, and upstream builds them into the server. Shipping needs a build without the ee code; re-check whether the core app builds and runs with those directories removed. HELD 2026-11-24 (v0.98.0): the release has an empty apps/server/src/ee and loads EeModule optionally, so the server core builds alone, but 70 files of the core client import apps/client/src/ee (26 modules, Docmost Enterprise License, production use needs a subscription). Shipping the web app means distributing that code or keeping a fork.

name: wallabag
note: Read-it-later service that saves web articles for offline reading, with tags, annotations, e-book export and mobile apps. v2.6.17, PHP (Symfony) on PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQLite. Added 2026-11-15. HELD 2026-11-15: 2.6.x is on Symfony 4.4 (EOL) and guzzle 5 (157 findings, framework majors). Re-check when 2.7.0 (Symfony 5.4) is released.
blockedReason: 2.6.17 runs on Symfony 4.4 (EOL) and guzzle 5: 157 findings that need framework major upgrades, not dependency floats. 2.7.0 (Symfony 5.4) is alpha.1 as of 2026-11-15.

name: Milvus
note: Scalable vector database for AI workloads. Measured 2026-09-30: releases ship only compose files and Wolfi has no package, so it is a from-source build: the C++ core through conan (about a hundred packages, often fetched as prebuilt binaries the scanner cannot see) plus a Rust component, a multi-hour build. Held until Wolfi packages it or a scanned from-source conan build is scoped.

name: Redpanda
note: Kafka-compatible streaming. Source-available, not OSI.
cleanAlternative: Kafka or Pulsar (Apache-2.0), both already shipped.

name: Istio
note: Service mesh built on Envoy. Ambient mode SHIPPED 2026-10-08: istiod, istio-cni and ztunnel charts on 1.30.5, gated on mTLS (HBONE) traffic between two pods. Still held: L7 waypoints and sidecar mode, which need the Istio proxyv2 image, which has no melange-buildable path.

name: Consul
note: HashiCorp Consul. BUSL-1.1: source-available, NOT OSI. Recommendation is to skip -- the mesh slot is already covered by Kuma (shipped) plus Linkerd and Istio in this wave, all OSI-licensed. Revisit on explicit demand.
cleanAlternative: Kuma (Apache-2.0) -- already shipped; or Linkerd / Istio.

name: Nomad
note: Workload scheduler. Source-available, not OSI.

name: SurrealDB
note: Multi-model database. Source-available, not OSI.

name: Apache Ozone
note: Scalable distributed object store (S3 + HDFS). Measured 2026-09-28: the 2.2.1 distribution carries 143 fixable findings in 22 jars. Most swap on their own line (netty 4.1.137, jackson 2.21.5, log4j 2.26.1), but jetty-server 9.4 is fixed only in 12.1, spring-core 5.3.39 only in 7.0 and aircompressor 0.27 only in 2.x. Needs an upstream move off those lines. Re-checked 2026-11-14: 2.2.2 still pins jetty 9.4.58 and spring 5.3.39.

name: SonarQube
note: Continuous code-quality and security inspection. Measured 2026-09-28: the 26.9 Community distribution carries 72 findings (4 critical), most inside its bundled Elasticsearch 9.4.3 (x-pack modules, transport-netty4) and in fat jars (sonar-application, the scanner engine). Needs the embedded Elasticsearch rebuilt or swapped before it can gate clean. Re-measured 2026-11-14 at 26.11 (Elasticsearch 9.4.7): 66 findings (3 critical). Every fix is now on its own line, and the Elasticsearch module jars (netty 4.1.137, lz4 1.11.4, jackson 2.18.11, guava) swap in place, but shaded copies sit inside three jars that need repacking: sonar-application (guava, jakarta.mail, ognl, org.json), the scanner engine (sshd 2.9.2) and elasticsearch-x-content (jackson-core 2.18.9).

name: Dokploy
note: Self-hostable PaaS on Docker Swarm. Open-core: most is Apache-2.0, the /proprietary parts are source-available (DSAL-1.0). Not a fit for the hardened catalog: it requires root, the Docker socket, and an initialized Swarm, so it cannot run nonroot or read-only.

name: Discourse
note: Ruby discussion and forum platform backed by PostgreSQL and Redis. Measured 2026-09-29 at 2026.9.0: the Gemfile.lock and pnpm-lock.yaml scan clean and Wolfi has ruby-3.4, ImageMagick 7, pngquant and oxipng, but two native gems ship only prebuilt binaries the scanner cannot see into: libv8-node (V8 for mini_racer, which PrettyText needs; a source build is a multi-hour Node V8 compile per arch) and sass-embedded (a bundled dart-sass, needed at runtime for theme CSS; Wolfi has the Dart SDK, so that half is buildable). Held on the V8 build.

name: Moodle
note: PHP learning management system backed by MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL. Measured 2026-09-29 at 5.2.3: the PHP side is fixable (5.2 runs composer install at build, so guzzle, psr7, aws-sdk-php, php-jwt, slim and jmespath float like mediawiki), but the H5P editor ships a prebuilt CKEditor 5 43.0.0 bundle (CVE-2024-45613, CVE-2026-28343 fixed only in 47.6.0; lodash-es CVE-2026-4800 HIGH). The fix is a four-major rebuild of a custom H5P build nothing would test, so the image is held until Moodle updates that bundle.

name: SuiteCRM
note: PHP customer relationship management application backed by MySQL or MariaDB. Measured 2026-10-04 on 8.10.2: the shipped frontend is Angular 18 (203 yarn.lock findings, fixed only in Angular 19 and later) and api-platform/core v3.4.17 is fixed only in v4, so both need major ports upstream; guzzle and flysystem would float. Held until SuiteCRM moves to Angular 19+ and api-platform 4.

name: Appsmith
note: Low-code internal-tools and admin-panel builder backed by PostgreSQL and Redis. Measured 2026-09-30 (v2.4.2, no release binaries, no Wolfi package): the upstream image is all-in-one under supervisor (Java server, React editor, Node RTS and MCP, Caddy, Redis, PostgreSQL and MongoDB). Appsmith has since removed PostgreSQL support (scripts/prepare_server_artifacts.sh builds only the MongoDB server), so the server needs MongoDB, which is SSPL. A clean image would run against an external MongoDB, or FerretDB/DocumentDB if Appsmith's use of transactions works there, which is unverified. Maven and yarn builds exceed the local gate, so it is gated in CI.

name: Gotenberg
note: Stateless HTML and URL to PDF conversion API. Recipe committed 2026-09-26 (Chromium variant; Wolfi has no LibreOffice): everything gates clean except chromium CVE-2026-13032, fixed in 149.0.7827.200. HELD long-term (re-checked 2026-11-14): Wolfi moved chromium out of its public repository in June 2026, so public Wolfi stays at 149.0.7827.53 and the fix will not arrive there. Prebuilt Chrome bundles libraries the scanner cannot see, and a from-source Chromium is beyond free CI runners. Upstream is at 9.5.0.

name: Apache Superset
note: Data exploration and business-intelligence dashboard platform backed by a metadata database and Redis. HELD 2026-11-11: 6.1.0 (latest) has 48 fixable findings in its pinned requirements (pyarrow 16.1 with a bundled OpenSSL, cryptography 46, PyJWT 2.10, pillow 11, Flask 2.3, urllib3, msgpack ...). Master already moved almost all of them (Flask 3.1, pillow 13, pyarrow 26, cryptography 50) together with code changes, so floating them onto 6.1.0 is unvalidated. Ship on the next release that carries master's pins; dnspython 2.9, paramiko 5 and pyasn1 0.6.5 are not on master yet either.
blockedReason: Superset pins `cryptography <47`, `msgpack <1.1`, and `pyarrow <19`, all below the versions that fix current HIGH CVEs, so it cannot reach 0 fixable CVEs without diverging from upstream's own dependency constraints. Built and tested; held until upstream relaxes the pins or backports the fixes.

name: Jellyfin
note: Self-hosted media server for movies, music, and live TV. Built 2026-09-29 from Wolfi's jellyfin 12.1 apks and it gates clean (0 fixable CVEs, boot test passes), but it is held: libSkiaSharp.so, a prebuilt NuGet binary from a Debian 10 clang 13 build, statically links libjpeg-turbo 2.1.5.1 (behind several upstream security fixes), libpng and other image libraries the scanner cannot see. Needs Skia built against the system libraries. The recipe is committed as blocked.

name: Apache Druid
note: Real-time analytics database for high-concurrency OLAP queries. Held 2026-09-26: the 37.0.0 distribution carries 137 findings. Two sit in the core lib/ and cannot be swapped: netty 3.10.6 (8 findings, end of life, fixes only exist in netty 4; Druid's HTTP client is built on it) and calcite-core 1.37.0 (the SQL planner, fixed in 1.42). Shipping needs Druid itself to move off both.

name: Open WebUI
note: Self-hosted web UI for chatting with local and remote LLMs. Checked 2026-09-27: the license is BSD-3-Clause plus a branding clause (the Open WebUI branding may not be altered for deployments above 50 users without permission), so it is not OSI. 0.11.4 also pins sentence-transformers, transformers, onnxruntime and opencv.

name: Dify
note: LLM application platform, another Flowise replacement. The license adds two conditions to Apache-2.0: no multi-tenant service without a written grant, and the console logo and copyright must stay. A rebuilt image keeps the frontend unmodified to meet the second; the first limits how users can run it, so this needs a decision before any work.

name: Langfuse
note: LLM observability and tracing platform backed by PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis and S3. Held 2026-09-27: the core is MIT, but ee/, web/src/ee and worker/src/ee are under the Langfuse Enterprise License, which forbids distributing them, and 80 core files import from those 120 files. An image needs a build with the ee paths removed and stubbed.

name: Kibana
note: Visualization and dashboards for Elasticsearch. Default distribution is Elastic-2.0, not OSI.
cleanAlternative: OpenSearch Dashboards (Apache-2.0) over OpenSearch, both open.

name: OpenSearch Dashboards
note: Visualization UI for OpenSearch. Measured 2026-09-26 at 3.8.0: the full bundle has 12 vulnerable npm packages, among them maplibre-gl 5.2.0 (CRITICAL, fixed only in 6.x) compiled into the maps, observability and anomaly-detection plugin bundles. The min distribution drops those plugins, leaving 7 patch-level fixes, but dompurify 3.4.11 is compiled into the Discover and chat UI bundles, so swapping node_modules would clear the scan and still ship the vulnerable code. Needs a from-source UI build (yarn build of OSD) to ship honestly. Re-measured 2026-10-07: an image that swaps node_modules scans 0 but still carries dompurify 3.4.11/3.4.12 in 8 browser bundles and maplibre-gl 5.2.0 in 3, so it is held. Upstream main has dompurify ^3.4.13 and maplibre-gl 6.4.1; Dashboards 3.9.0 (unreleased) is the next build to measure.
blockedReason: OpenSearch Dashboards bundles Node dependencies pinned below their CVE fixes, so the image cannot reach 0 fixable CVEs without diverging from the upstream bundle. Built and tested; held until upstream updates them.

name: Logstash
note: Server-side log and event processing pipeline. Default distribution is Elastic-2.0, not OSI.
cleanAlternative: Vector (MPL-2.0) or Fluentd (Apache-2.0), both open pipelines.

name: KeyDB
note: Multi-threaded Redis fork; BSD-licensed and Redis-protocol compatible. Held 2026-09-25: upstream is dormant (last release 6.3.4 in October 2023, last push May 2024) on a Redis 6.2 base, so it misses the Lua and protocol fixes Redis and Valkey shipped since. Valkey covers the slot.

name: ArangoDB
note: Multi-model database for documents, graphs, and key-value. Checked 2026-09-27: the repository LICENSE is the Business Source License 1.1, not Apache-2.0.

name: JanusGraph
note: Distributed graph database over pluggable storage backends. Measured 2026-09-26: the newest release (1.1.0, 2024-11) carries 57 vulnerable packages (4 CRITICAL, 35 HIGH) in its dist. The project is active but has not released since; shipping at 0 CVEs needs a from-source Maven build with dependency management across the tree.

name: Wazuh
note: SIEM and XDR platform with manager, indexer, and dashboard components. Measured 2026-11-02 on 4.14.9: the manager package scans 36 findings, all Python packages in its embedded framework (PyJWT, urllib3, pyasn1, setuptools; fixable by upgrading them), but that framework is Wazuh's own CPython 3.10 build (3.10 reached end of life in October 2026), so the manager needs a from-source build on a supported Python. The dashboard is an OpenSearch Dashboards fork (the same compiled-bundle hold as opensearch-dashboards) and the indexer an OpenSearch fork. 5.0.0 is at rc2 across all three; re-measure at 5.0 GA before starting.

name: Camunda
note: Process automation and BPMN orchestration including the Zeebe engine. Checked 2026-09-27: the repository is under the Camunda License 1.0, not Apache-2.0.

name: search-stack
note: Umbrella: OpenSearch + OpenSearch Dashboards, search with a UI. Held 2026-10-07: chart built and gated (OpenSearch document found through Dashboards), but it bundles the opensearch-dashboards image, which is held (see that entry).

name: Percona PMM
note: Percona Monitoring and Management, deep MySQL/PostgreSQL/MongoDB observability (query analytics) built on Prometheus, Grafana and VictoriaMetrics. AGPL, OSI-approved. Sized 2026-10-08 at v3.9.1 (no release binaries): pmm-server is one container that an Ansible playbook assembles on Oracle Linux 9 from eight RPMs built in the repo (pmm-managed, qan-api2, vmproxy, pmm-dump, pmm-ui, percona-dashboards) plus Percona forks of Grafana (12.4.5, frontend changes, so a full Node build unlike our grafana image) and VictoriaMetrics (pmm-6401-v1.149.0), with ClickHouse, PostgreSQL 14, nginx and supervisord in the same image. Several images of work plus a multi-process supervisor design; it waits for local gates (the btrfs metadata hold).

name: Tiny RDM
note: Modern Redis/Valkey desktop GUI (Wails/Go+Vue). A desktop client, not a deployable server, so it falls outside the hardened in-cluster image model, a web Redis UI (e.g. redis-commander) would be the cache-stack UI instead.

name: OneDev
note: Self-hosted Git server with built-in CI/CD, issues and kanban (Java). Heavier than Gitea/Gogs but far lighter than GitLab; an all-in-one gitops-stack backend option. Measured 2026-10-07 at 16.8.5 (47 findings): jackson-databind/core 2.22.2 in lib/ swap cleanly, but Hazelcast 5.7.0 (its newest release) relocates jackson 2.21.2 and tools.jackson 3.1.2 under com/hazelcast/shaded/, which needs a bytecode relocation rewrite or a Hazelcast release; logback 1.4.14 needs the 1.5 line; boot/ ships prebuilt Tanuki wrapper binaries. HELD 2026-11-23: OneDev 17.x cannot ship as open source. The MIT repo's ce profile builds, but the server does not boot: Guice finds no implementation for ClusterService, AuditService, StorageService, SubscriptionService and JobTerminalService, which live in the server-ee git submodule (https://code.onedev.io/onedev/server-ee.git, private: clone asks for credentials). The upstream distribution bundles io.onedev.server-ee-17.2.2.jar with license-key classes. Prepared and kept for a re-check: Hazelcast 5.7.0 rebuilt from source with jackson 2.21.7/3.1.7 and org.json 20260719 scans 0. Re-check when server-ee becomes public or the core services move back into server-core.

name: Percona XtraDB Cluster Operator
note: Operator for Percona XtraDB Cluster (MySQL): synchronous multi-primary HA via Galera, with automated backups and point-in-time recovery. Image SHIPPED 2026-09-27 (1.18.0, 1.19.1, 1.20.0; it is also the pods' init image). Chart HELD: in the kind gate the operator creates the cluster and its init containers complete, but the Percona 8.4.8 database pod starts mysqld with wsrep provider none and never becomes ready, and it does the same with upstream's init image and with the 8.0 database image. Percona's forum reports the same failure in kind and minikube on Linux; the chart waits for a gate on a non-kind cluster.

name: OwnTracks Recorder
note: Stores and serves location data from OwnTracks apps (HTTP or MQTT), with a map UI and an API (C, LMDB). 1.0.7 (2026-11-19). Pairs with Traccar. Added 2026-11-25 as next after the IT-Tools fork shipped. HELD 2026-11-25: its HTTP server is a vendored copy of Cesanta Mongoose 5.6 (2014), invisible to the scanner and many security releases behind; newer Mongoose changed the API, so a swap means rewriting the HTTP layer. Re-check when upstream moves off Mongoose 5.6.

name: Rundeck
note: Runbook automation and job scheduler: run scripts and commands across nodes with access control, a web UI and an API (Java/Grails). 6.3.0. Added 2026-11-23 as next after CommaFeed shipped. HELD 2026-11-23: 6.3.0 has no fetchable release artifact (Maven Central stops at 6.0.1, GitHub releases carry no assets, download.rundeck.org refuses automated fetches), so it means a full Grails + Vue source build. Re-check when a pinnable war is published.

name: Conduit
note: Lightweight Matrix chat homeserver in one Rust binary with an embedded database (RocksDB). v0.10.17 (GitLab famedly/conduit). Added 2026-11-23 as next after mox shipped. HELD 2026-11-23 (images#148): needs hickory-resolver 0.26, jsonwebtoken 10.3+, opentelemetry 0.32 and a newer reqwest, which upstream has not taken; with them bumped, axum-server 0.7.2 no longer compiles against the updated hyper stack. Re-check when upstream moves.

name: MongoDB Community Operator
note: MongoDB Community Kubernetes Operator: replica-set HA, automated failover, and TLS via CRDs. The operator is Apache-2.0; note the MongoDB server it deploys is SSPL (not OSI). Held 2026-10-07: the community operator repo is archived; its successor mongodb/mongodb-kubernetes (1.13.0, Apache-2.0 for Community clusters) runs every member beside mongodb-agent, a closed-source binary its Dockerfile downloads prebuilt (agent 109.0.1.9310-1), which cannot be built or scanned.

name: mongodb-ha-stack
note: Operator-based HA MongoDB: MongoDB Community Operator + a metrics exporter, replica-set failover. CRD-driven. The operator is Apache-2.0, but MongoDB itself is SSPL (not OSI), so the stack inherits that caution.
cleanAlternative: FerretDB (Apache-2.0) on the pg-ha-stack, a MongoDB-compatible, fully-open document database over PostgreSQL.

name: MinIO
note: S3-compatible object storage, AGPL-3.0. Will not ship: minio/minio was archived on 2026-04-25 and minio/mc earlier (read-only, no maintenance; upstream points to its proprietary AIStor editions). The last server release is RELEASE.2025-10-15T17-29-55Z, and an archived server gets no CVE fixes.
cleanAlternative: SeaweedFS, Garage, RustFS or Ceph RGW (all in the catalog)
blockedReason: Archived upstream on 2026-04-25: no releases or CVE fixes.

name: Kaniko
note: Build container images inside Kubernetes without a daemon. Held 2026-09-25: Google archived it in June 2025 (continued as osscontainertools/kaniko 1.28 and chainguard-dev/kaniko 1.25), and the executor unpacks image layers over its own root filesystem, so it must run as root, against the nonroot rule. BuildKit rootless is the likelier fit.

name: KubeVirt
note: Run virtual machines as Kubernetes workloads. Sized 2026-10-08 at v1.9.0: upstream assembles its images with Bazel from CentOS Stream 9 RPMs (libvirt, qemu-kvm, passt). Wolfi has qemu 11.1.2 but no libvirt or passt package, so virt-launcher needs both built from source alongside the Go components (virt-operator, virt-api, virt-controller, virt-handler); it waits for local gates.

name: Apicurio Registry
note: API and schema registry for Kafka, Avro, and Protobuf. Measured 2026-09-25: the 3.3.3 app distribution carries 467 findings; 26 in-place jar swaps clear all but opentelemetry-api 1.57.0 (CVE-2026-45292, fixed only in 1.62.0), which adds packages the prebuilt Quarkus index cannot load. Needs a source build that regenerates the index. Re-checked 2026-11-14: 3.3.4 still builds on Quarkus 3.33.4.1, whose BOM pins opentelemetry-api 1.57.0. Re-checked 2026-11-23: 3.3.5 (2026-11-19) is still on Quarkus 3.33.4.1.

name: Couchbase
note: Distributed document database. Source-available, not OSI.

name: Aerospike
note: Real-time key-value database; community edition is AGPL. Measured 2026-11-02 on v8.2.0.0: a C server (AGPLv3, modules Apache-2.0) with 12 vendored native libraries as git submodules, which no scanner sees in the binary, so each pin is checked by hand: PCRE2 10.47, ICU 78.3 and Lua 5.4 are current, but jansson is 2.13.1 (CVE-2020-36325, fixed 2.14; Wolfi ships 2.15.1) and abseil-cpp is a February 2023 snapshot, before the CVE-2025-0838 hash-container fix (20250127). HELD 2026-11-02: the public source cannot be built as tagged. The jemalloc submodule pins c80c613a, a commit absent from aerospike/jemalloc (its newest public commit is from 2018), and the build expects a jem_-prefixed jemalloc. Aerospike publishes no source tarball, only binary packages (newest 8.2.0.1), and those link jansson 2.13.1 and the 2023 abseil statically where no scanner sees them, so they cannot be shipped either. Unblock: the jemalloc commit becomes public (or a source tarball appears) and the tag moves jansson and abseil past their fixes.

name: Liquibase
note: Database schema change and migration management. Relicensed: 5.x is under the Functional Source License 1.1 (source-available, Apache-2.0 two years after each release, competing use restricted); the last Apache-2.0 release is 4.33.0 and its line is no longer patched. Flyway (Apache-2.0) covers the same job.

name: Cortex
note: Horizontally scalable, multi-tenant Prometheus storage. Held 2026-10-05: four prometheus/prometheus CVEs (two HIGH) are fixed only in 0.311.3 (Prometheus 3.11.3), but Cortex 1.21.1 is on 0.308.1 and imports tsdb/errors, removed in Prometheus 3.10; Cortex master is on 0.309.1 and still imports it. Unblocks when a Cortex release moves to Prometheus 3.11.

name: Kubeflow Pipelines
note: ML pipeline orchestration on Kubernetes. Partly built 2026-10-20 (2.17.2): api-server, persistence agent, scheduled workflow controller, driver, launcher and frontend images passed the CVE gate (images 405e86c8). The chart is held: v2 runs need the ML Metadata store server, whose binary (Wolfi 1.17.1, upstream 1.21.0) statically links sqlite 3.39.2, zlib 1.2.12, gRPC 1.46.3, MariaDB Connector/C 3.0.8 and libpq 12.1, invisible to the scanner. Unblock: an MLMD release on current libraries, or our own Bazel build against Wolfi system libraries.

name: TensorFlow Serving
note: High-performance serving system for TensorFlow models. Measured 2026-10-20 at 2.21.0: tensorflow_model_server is a Bazel build of all of TensorFlow (hours per arch, past the CI budget), and the official binary links TensorFlow, gRPC, protobuf and absl statically, so the scanner cannot read what is inside. Hold until a source build fits the CI budget.

name: AnythingLLM
note: Self-hosted chat-with-your-documents LLM application. Measured 2026-10-20 at v1.18.0: the upstream image scans 445 fixable npm findings in 61 packages, ships 24 native .node addons, and runs on Prisma's prebuilt Rust query engine (libquery_engine .so.node), which the scanner cannot read. Hold until a build with prisma-engines from source (cargo auditable) is sized.

name: XWiki
note: Enterprise wiki and structured collaboration platform. Measured 2026-10-14 (17.10.13 LTS and 18.8.0): recipe written, held before CI. After safe jar swaps 8 fixable findings remain on both lines: bundled solr-core 9.4.1 (fixes need Solr 9.8 to 9.10.1, a whole Solr and Lucene jar set), the Jetty 10.0.26 client (fixes only on Jetty 11/12, no 10.x release) and opennlp-tools (fix only in 2.x). XWiki master still pins Solr 9.4.1. Unblocks with an XWiki release on Solr 9.10.1 or newer and a fixed Jetty client.

name: Rocket.Chat
note: Self-hosted team chat platform backed by MongoDB. Measured 2026-10-20 at 8.9.0: the official build compiles apps/meteor/ee/ and ee/ (Rocket.Chat Enterprise license, not OSI) into the same Meteor bundle, so a clean MIT-only image means a source build with the ee packages removed; the upstream image also scans 160 fixable npm findings in 44 packages. Hold until a source build without ee/ is sized.

name: Chromium
note: Headless browser for rendering, scraping, and PDF export.

name: ai-stack
note: Ollama (or vLLM) + Open WebUI + Qdrant, self-hosted LLM serving, a chat UI, and a vector DB for retrieval-augmented generation. Qdrant is built; needs Ollama/vLLM + Open WebUI images.

name: analytics-stack
note: Apache Superset + Trino + PostgreSQL, federated SQL analytics with self-service BI dashboards. PostgreSQL is built; needs Superset + Trino.

name: Higress
note: Alibaba's Istio+Envoy-based gateway. Two components (higress-core, higress-console) and it inherits Istio/Envoy build weight. Measured 2026-10-20 at v2.2.5: the gateway image runs Higress's own patched Envoy (a Bazel build, hours per arch, past the CI budget; same wall as Cilium Envoy) plus pilot-agent, and scans 163 Go findings; the controller scans 85 Go findings on top of 446 Ubuntu ones. The Go parts are buildable; the patched Envoy is the hold.

name: Apache ShenYu
note: Java API gateway. shenyu-bootstrap + shenyu-admin; admin needs a database. Held 2026-10-19: the 2.7.1 dists (trivy rootfs) carry 234 (admin) and 309 (bootstrap) fixable findings, 27 CRITICAL, on Spring Boot 3.3.1 / Spring 6.1.10 whose fixes sit in Boot 4 and Spring 7, plus Shiro 1.13 (fix 2.x), Tomcat 10.1.25 and fastjson 1.2.76; not jar-swappable. Unblock: an upstream release on a current Spring line.

name: Consul Dataplane
note: Envoy-based sidecar for Consul. MPL, so cleaner than the BUSL server. Checked 2026-11-11: MPL-2.0, but useful only with the Consul server (BUSL, not in the catalog), and the dataplane bundles Envoy, which is on an upstream hold here.

name: Consul K8s Control Plane
note: The operator that makes Consul work on Kubernetes. Checked 2026-11-11: MPL-2.0, but useful only with the Consul server (BUSL, not in the catalog).

name: Tinyproxy
note: Small HTTP/HTTPS forward proxy in C, a light alternative to Squid for egress filtering. Researched 2026-11-05: 1.11.3 (2026-03-07), autotools build on Wolfi, no bundled dependencies. Held 2026-11-11: 1.11.3, the latest release, carries CVE-2026-54387 and -54388 (request smuggling, duplicate Content-Length), CVE-2026-55202 (Host header auth spoofing), CVE-2026-31842 and CVE-2026-3945; the fixes are commits on master (ff45d3b, 364cdb6, 09312a1) with no release. Ship when a release contains them.

name: Pomerium
note: Identity-aware access proxy (zero-trust access to internal apps with SSO and per-route policy). HELD 2026-11-11: the source is Apache-2.0, but official builds released after 2026-11-01 (0.34.0 on) are under the Pomerium Community Edition License 1.0 (free only under US$10M revenue and 100 staff), and the Go binary embeds Pomerium's own prebuilt Envoy, which reports that licence. A clean build needs Envoy built from source, which is itself on an upstream hold here. 0.33.6 (before the change) is the last fully Apache build.

name: LLDAP
note: Light LDAP server for user and group management with a web UI, as an identity backend for apps that speak LDAP. Added 2026-11-12: v0.6.3, maintained, GPL-3.0, Rust with a Rust/WASM frontend. HELD 2026-11-12: the server's auth crate pins opaque-ke 0.7, which needs curve25519-dalek 3.2.0 (CVE-2024-58262, fixed in 4.1.3); upstream main is still on both. opaque-ke 2+ changes the password protocol (stored passwords and the WASM client), so it cannot be bumped in a recipe. Also reqwest 0.11 pulls rustls 0.21 / rustls-webpki 0.101 (GHSA-82j2-j2ch-gfr8). Revisit when upstream moves to opaque-ke 2+.

name: Crunchy PGO
note: PostgreSQL clusters with pgBackRest backups, HA and a PostgresCluster custom resource. v6.0.2, Go. Added 2026-11-13 (operators track). Held 2026-11-14: the operator is Apache-2.0, but every cluster it creates runs Crunchy's own PostgreSQL image (PostgreSQL under /usr/pgsql-N, Patroni, and pgBackRest and scripts under /opt/crunchy), which QuenchWorks does not build. A hardened image with that layout comes first, as with Spilo for the Zalando operator.

name: Spark Operator
note: Kubeflow Spark operator: SparkApplication and ScheduledSparkApplication resources. v2.6.0, Go. Added 2026-11-13 (operators track). Held 2026-11-14: the operator image must carry the Spark distribution (it runs spark-submit), and our Spark build is a long Maven build whose package other recipes cannot reuse yet.

name: Team Chat Stack
note: Mattermost + PostgreSQL + Keycloak: team chat with single sign-on already configured. Added 2026-11-13 (stacks track): every component already has a QuenchWorks chart. Held 2026-11-14: Mattermost's OpenID Connect sign-in (which Keycloak would use) is a Professional/Enterprise feature, and Mattermost v11 removes GitLab SSO, the only provider Team Edition had, so the stack cannot ship single sign-on on the free edition. Revisit if Mattermost Entry ships SSO under terms the catalog can carry.

name: HedgeDoc
note: Collaborative real-time Markdown editor (Node, yarn 4). HELD 2026-11-15: 1.12.1 and 1.12.2 are withdrawn upstream ("might break your instance"), so 1.12.0 is the release. Its production install (yarn workspaces focus --production) carries 146 fixable and 163 total findings. HedgeDoc itself pins sequelize 5 (fixes need 6, a breaking major for its models and migrations), and request 2.88 and xmldom 0.1.31 have no fix at all; dozens of transitive pins (undici, tar 6, axios, qs, markdown-it) would need swaps on top. Revisit when upstream moves to sequelize 6 or HedgeDoc 2 ships.

name: RustDesk Server
blockedReason: 1.1.16 locks rustls 0.20/0.21, sqlx 0.6, jsonwebtoken 8 and ring 0.16; their fixes are major upgrades the server code would need to adopt.
note: Self-hosted rendezvous (hbbs) and relay (hbbr) servers for RustDesk remote desktop. v1.1.16, Rust. HELD 2026-11-16: the Cargo.lock carries rustls 0.20/0.21, sqlx 0.6, jsonwebtoken 8 and other old crates whose fixes need major upgrades. Re-check at the next release.

name: LinkAce
blockedReason: 2.6.3 is on Laravel 11.57.0; its HIGH finding is fixed only in Laravel 12.60.0 and 13.10.0, a major the app has not moved to.
note: Self-hosted bookmark archive with tags, lists, link checks and Internet Archive backups. v2.6.3, PHP / Laravel 11. HELD 2026-11-16: laravel/framework 11.57.0 carries a HIGH fixed only on the 12 and 13 lines; re-check when LinkAce moves to Laravel 12.

name: HydraDB
note: Graph database on object storage (SlateDB on S3-compatible storage) with OpenCypher queries, aimed at AI workloads. v0.4.0 (2026-11-14), Rust; builds need libcypher-parser and SuiteSparse GraphBLAS. Checked 2026-11-16: Elastic License 2.0, source-available and not OSI (no hosted or managed service offering), like Kibana and Logstash here. Young project (first release 2026-09); size the Cargo.lock and the native libraries before it moves up.

name: Kavita
note: Reading server for manga, comics and ebooks with a web reader, OPDS and user libraries (.NET). HELD 2026-11-16 at v0.9.1.4: the release bundles the .NET 10.0.3 runtime (many HIGH/CRITICAL fixed in 10.0.13+), so it needs a from-source build on Wolfi dotnet-10, and it uses AutoMapper 12, whose fixes are in 15.x/16.x, where AutoMapper moved to a commercial license. Re-check when Kavita replaces or upgrades AutoMapper. Komga (shipped 2026-11-16) covers the same need.
blockedReason: AutoMapper 12 has HIGH findings fixed only in 15.x/16.x (commercial license); the bundled .NET 10.0.3 runtime needs a from-source build.

name: Fider
note: Feedback and feature-voting portal (Go + React, PostgreSQL). Sized 2026-11-16 at v0.40.0: the Go module needs only the usual x/* floors, but server-side rendering runs on rogchap.com/v8go v0.9.0 (released 2023-03, upstream inactive since 2024-08), which links a 2023 V8 statically; scanners cannot see that V8 and a recipe cannot patch it. HELD until Fider moves to a maintained JS engine or v8go fork.
blockedReason: Statically linked V8 from v8go 0.9.0 (2023), invisible to scanners and not patchable in a recipe.

name: GoatCounter
note: Privacy-friendly web analytics (Go, SQLite or PostgreSQL). Sized 2026-11-16 at v2.7.0: buildable (house golang.org/x floors plus go-chi 5.4.0 clear every finding). The license is EUPL-1.2 with a trimmed Compatible Licenses appendix, so it is not an OSI-approved text; caution until that is reviewed.

name: Shynet
note: Privacy-friendly web analytics (Django). Sized 2026-11-16 at v0.14.0 (upstream idle since 2026-03): the lock pins Django 4.1 (EOL) and django-allauth 0.45, whose fixes are in 65.x, an incompatible rewrite of the integration; plus gunicorn 20, aiohttp 3.9, cryptography 42. HELD until upstream moves to a supported Django and allauth.
blockedReason: Django 4.1 (EOL) and django-allauth 0.45: fixes need framework major upgrades.

name: LinkStack
note: Self-hosted link-in-bio page (a Linktree alternative) with themes and an admin panel, PHP / Laravel. HELD 2026-11-19: 4.8.8 is on Laravel 9.52 (end of life); its 56 lockfile findings in 15 packages include laravel/framework advisories fixed only on 10 and later, so it cannot pass the CVE gate without a framework major. Re-check when LinkStack moves to Laravel 11 or 12.

name: Shannon
note: AI pentester for web applications and APIs: reads the source, then runs real exploits against the running app to confirm findings. TypeScript, v3.6.1 (2026-11-20). Requested 2026-11-22 alongside ARTEX. For authorized testing only. HELD 2026-11-23 at v3.6.1: the npm tree (374 packages) clears with same-major pnpm overrides, but the worker drives Chromium through Playwright, and public Wolfi chromium is frozen at 149.0.7827.53 with 1,600+ fixable findings (the wall that holds Gotenberg and Linkwarden). It also needs a Temporal server. Re-check when a scanner-clean Chromium is available.

name: PentestGPT
note: LLM-driven agentic penetration testing framework (reasoning, generation and parsing modules guiding the operator through a test). Python, v1.0.0 (2025-12-24). Requested 2026-11-22 alongside ARTEX. For authorized testing only. HELD 2026-11-23 at v1.0.0: it is a front end for the Claude Code CLI, which its image installs from npm (@anthropic-ai/claude-code, proprietary terms), so the image cannot redistribute its core.

name: HexStrike AI
note: MCP server that gives AI agents 150+ security tools (recon, web, binary, cloud) behind one interface. Python. No tagged releases (rolling main), so the image would track commits; size it first. Requested 2026-11-22 alongside ARTEX. For authorized testing only.

name: Nebula (berylliumsec)
note: AI-assisted penetration testing harness: a terminal assistant that runs and interprets security tools and keeps notes. Python, nebula-v3.0.46 (2026-11-09). Not the Nebula mesh VPN already in the catalog. Requested 2026-11-22 alongside ARTEX. HELD 2026-11-23 at nebula-v3.0.46: its browser daemon and knowledge tools drive Chromium through Playwright (src/nebula/v3/browserd.py, knowledge.py), and public Wolfi chromium is frozen with 1,600+ fixable findings. The Python locks otherwise clear with floors.

name: Faraday
note: Collaborative pentest and vulnerability management workspace that aggregates tool output (Nmap, Burp, Nessus, ...). Python on PostgreSQL, v5.25.4 (2026-10-29). Requested 2026-11-22 alongside ARTEX. HELD 2026-11-23 at 5.25.4: pyproject pins flask<3, bleach<5 and flask-limiter<3, while the uv.lock findings need Werkzeug 3 (8 CVEs), bleach 6 and Pillow 13 (56 CVEs at 12.2). Re-check when Faraday moves to Flask 3.

name: Stirling-PDF
note: Self-hosted PDF toolbox (merge, split, OCR, convert, sign). Checked 2026-11-25 at v3.5.0: open-core: app/proprietary, app/saas, engine/ and several frontend/src directories are under separate non-MIT licenses, and the released Stirling-PDF-server.jar includes them. Shipping needs a build without those directories.

name: Tandoor Recipes
note: Recipe manager and meal planner (Django). Checked 2026-11-25 at 2.7.6: AGPL-3.0 with the Commons Clause, which forbids selling the software, so it is not OSI open source. Will not ship unless relicensed.

name: Plausible Analytics
note: Privacy-friendly web analytics (Community Edition): Elixir/Phoenix on PostgreSQL and ClickHouse (both in the catalog). v3.2.2 (2026-11-23). Build MIX_ENV=ce from source with extra/ deleted first (proprietary, no rights granted; the CE build does not compile it). Toolchain: Erlang 28 (Wolfi erlang-28) and Elixir 1.20.4 (Wolfi has 1.19: build Elixir from source). Added 2026-11-24 as next after wallabag (held on Symfony 4.4) and Docmost (client imports Enterprise code).
